item.name: [Adjustable Windproof Rope] Outdoor Bucket Hat Oversized Brim Sunscreen Sunshade Breathable Not Stuffy Travel Camping Fishing
item.title: [Adjustable Windproof Rope] Outdoor Bucket Hat Oversized Brim Sunscreen Sunshade Breathable Not Stuffy Travel Camping Fishing
item.description:
Wide Brim Design, All-Round Sunshade:
This Fisherman Hat Is Designed With Wide Brim, Which Can Effectively Block Sunlight From Multiple Angles, Protect Your Face And Neck From Uv Rays.
The Wide-Brimmed Design Not Only Increases The Sunshade Area Of The Hat, But Also Improves The Comfort Of Wearing, So That You Can Be More Comfortable During Outdoor Activities.
Breathable Material, Light And Comfortable:
The Hat Is Made Of High-Quality Breathable Material, Able To Ensure The Head Air Circulation When Wearing, Reduce The Sultry Feeling, So That You Can Still Keep You Fresh In Hot Weather.
The Lightweight Material Reduces The Weight Of The Hat, And It Will Not Feel Burdensome To Wear For A Long Time, Suitable For Long Time Outdoor Activities Such As Fishing, Climbing, Etc.
Multi-Function Use, Applicable To Various Scenarios:
This Bucket Hat Is Not Only Suitable For Wearing When Fishing, But Also Meets The Needs Of A Variety Of Outdoor Activities Such As Mountaineering, Hiking, Picnic, Etc.
Wide Brim Design And Breathable Material Make It An Ideal Sun Hat, Which Can Bring You A Comfortable Wearing Experience Whether It Is On Beach Vacation, Outdoor Camping Or Urban Leisure.
Hat Circumference: 56-59cm

services.title: 15-Day Free Returns

services.description: Protects your new item for 6 months from date of delivery, covering total loss as a result of Accidental & Liquid damage.
